sentences.text: Lindsay Dee Lohan -LRB- born July 2 , 1986 -RRB- is an American actress and singer .	Lindsay	Lindsay (TV series)
Lohan began her career as a child fashion model when she was three , and was later featured on the soap opera Another World for a year when she was 10 .	Another World	Another World (TV series)
At age 11 , Lohan made her motion picture debut in Disney 's commercially and critically successful 1998 remake of The Parent Trap .
Her next major motion picture , Disney 's 2003 remake of Freaky Friday , was also a critical and commercial success .

With the release of Mean Girls -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , another critical and commercial success , and Disney 's Herbie : Fully Loaded -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , another commercial success , Lohan became a teen idol sensation , a household name and a frequent focus of paparazzi and tabloids .	Mean Girls	Mean Girls	teen idol sensation	Teen idol
However , Lohan 's next starring role in the romantic comedy Just My Luck -LRB- 2006 -RRB- , received poor reviews and was only a modest commercial success .	Just My Luck	Just My Luck (2006 film)

Following Just My Luck , Lohan focused on smaller , more mature roles in independent movies , receiving positive comments on her work , including A Prairie Home Companion -LRB- 2006 -RRB- , Bobby -LRB- 2006 -RRB- and Chapter 27 -LRB- 2007 -RRB- .	Just My Luck	Just My Luck (2006 film)	A Prairie Home Companion	A Prairie Home Companion (film)	Bobby	Bobby (2006 film)	Chapter 27	Chapter 27
After recording several songs for her movie soundtracks , Lohan signed with Casablanca Records .	Casablanca	Casablanca Records	Casablanca Records	Casablanca Records

Lohan 's debut studio album , titled Speak , was released in December 2004 and became the first high-seller from Casablanca in several years , selling 1 million copies in the United States alone and peaking at number four on the Billboard 200 .	Casablanca	Casablanca Records	Speak	Speak (Lindsay Lohan album)
Though the album received mostly lukewarm reviews , it was certified platinum and sold over 4 million copies worldwide .	platinum	Music recording sales certification
Lohan 's second album , titled A Little More Personal -LRB- Raw -RRB- , was released in December 2005 and featured darker material than her debut had .
That album received mixed reviews , and it was certified gold .	gold	Music recording sales certification

In 2007 , two driving under the influence incidents led to Lohan being put on probation , and together with three visits to rehabilitation facilities caused the loss of several movie deals .	driving under the influence	driving under the influence	probation	probation	rehabilitation facilities	Drug rehabilitation
In 2008 and 2009 , Lohan worked as a fashion model and launched the clothing line 6126 .	6126	6126 (clothing line)
She resumed her acting career with TV work in 2008 , and starred in the TV film Labor Pains -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Labor Pains	Labor Pains
She appeared in Robert Rodriguez 's feature film Machete -LRB- 2010 -RRB- .	Robert Rodriguez	Robert Rodriguez	Machete	Machete (film)
Between 2010 and 2013 , Lohan went into rehabilitation three times , and spent much of her time entangled in legal problems stemming from misdemeanors and probation violations .	probation	probation

In 2012 and 2013 , she did further television work , including starring as Elizabeth Taylor in the biographical TV film Liz & Dick -LRB- 2012 -RRB- .	Elizabeth Taylor	Elizabeth Taylor	Liz & Dick	Liz & Dick
In 2013 , she starred in Paul Schrader 's independent film The Canyons .	Paul Schrader	Paul Schrader	The Canyons	The Canyons (film)

In 2014 , the docu-series Lindsay aired on the Oprah Winfrey Network , and Lohan made her stage debut in the London West End production of Speed-the-Plow .
